title.narrative: Modernisation of the Dosimetric Control System in the Exclusion Zone and Environmental (Radiation) Monitoring at the ¿Vektor¿ Complex and the ¿Buriakivka¿ Disposal Facility - U4.01/18B

description.narrative: The Action will contribute to the improvement of the radiation safety within the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone (ChEZ) by upgrading (i) environmental monitoring around the Vektor Complex and the Buriakivka near-surface disposal facility and (ii) dosimetric control within the ChEZ.
